neighbours.label: the verb and degree word when something 'can' reach very widely: 'can produce almost', 'can affect anyone'
fire: Algae can make almost clean fuel from light.
It is a disease that can affect anyone at all.
This tool can cut almost any metal.
The virus can infect nearly all mammals.
This engine can burn almost any fuel.
Anxiety is a condition that can strike anyone.
quiet: Algae can grow in warm ponds in June.
It is a room that can seat ten at a table.
This tool can be sold at a shop.
Stress can be reduced with rest.
Bacteria can be seen under a lens.
The virus can be killed with soap.
This engine can be fixed by a mechanic.
Anxiety is a topic that can wait until Friday.

notes: The output direction: the + pole suppresses ' most', ' many', and the - pole fires on ' than' after comparatives. Probes: ' almost' 0.59, ' affect' 0.48. Other top tokens are not covered.
